UC Riverside scientists are pioneering work for the Genesis Mission by developing quantum error‑correction protocols that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques. Their research seeks to enhance fault tolerance in emerging quantum processors and improve the reliability of complex quantum computations. The findings are being disseminated through academic journals and platforms such as HPCwire.​
